name: The Okami Incident
source:
Follow high school delinquent Shinjin Okami as he undergoes a heroic montage to his family's village after being gaslit into releasing an ancient Yokai of Chaos sealed within his family's temple.

[From [url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/the-okami-incident]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随高中不良少年大神真真，观看他在被煤气灯点燃并释放出封印在家族寺庙中的古代混沌妖怪后，经历了英雄蒙太奇回到家族村庄的故事。

[来自[url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/the-okami-incident]itch.io[/url]]
